specification.title: Provider budget exhaustion stops the investigation
specification.description: Provider budget exhaustion stops with the specific reason.
specification.purpose: Verify exhaustion of the per-investigation provider budget stops with the dedicated stop reason instead of continuing unbounded work.
specification.operational_relevance: Provider calls are the principal cost driver; hard budget enforcement protects operators from cost blowouts.
specification.regression_risk: The coordinator could exceed the provider cap or stop without the provider_budget_exhausted reason.

required: Total provider calls respect the declared maximum
forbidden: The total provider call count exceeds the declared provider budget
